profile.headline: Software Engineer, Mathematician, Biologist, Computational Theorist, Rapid Learner, Agent of Curiosity
profile.summary: I enjoy deep dives in new fields, drawing novel connections, combining knowledge learned and discovered to solve cross-disciplinary problems and explore new directions, and sharing knowledge and insights.  Very interested in exploring the frontiers of (topological) quantum computing, hardware acceleration of ML and other workloads, verifiable computing, and the future of network and cloud platform architecture.  Passionate about leadership opportunities and personal growth.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I work on design and optimization of our internal graph query language that serves XX million QPS of production Search traffic and is responsible for nearly half of the #1 search results across all Search queries. I apply exciting - if somewhat obscure - abstract nonsense, allegory theory, and abstract rewrite systems theory plus programming language theory and type systems theory to deliver significant performance optimizations that power growth of the heart of structured search over public data that provides rich content and answers to users of Google Search.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer for Google Search
positions.description: Oncall for Search Intelligence SRE.  Service Lead for Speech SRE in MTV.  I manage priorities for Speech SRE, do capacity planning, make systematic reliability improvements, review feature designs for reliability and scalability, contribute production code to improve reliability, teach how Speech works and how to manage it in production, and constantly work to replace myself with a few small Go programs.  I've worked closely with Dialogflow on reliability improvements and am developing an additional specialization in the Google Assistant.  I am actively seeking out growth and leadership opportunities and have contributed to design and prototype of a service for automated triage assistance as a 20% project.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer for Dialogflow
positions.description: Worked with Dialogflow (fka API.AI), which provides a convenient web UI for building conversational agents (aka bots) and a serving stack for running those agents, to improve the reliability of their service running on Kubernetes on GCE.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintenance, upgrades, and new development related to Investor Ownership analytics functions in the Bloomberg Terminal.  Design of new backend system architecture for onboarding and processing of new data sources.

positions.title: Scientific Informatics Developer
positions.description:
Official description: "Provide programming support for cancer-related biomedical research in the Proteomics Shared Resource. Work will include analysis of high-throughput mass spectrometry data, development of computational methods and user interface development."

In practice, I maintain, debug, and regularly update the BSR's Galaxy installation, a web-based platform for genomic data analysis used by hundreds of laboratory scientists to interpret their experimental results.  I help and train scientists in the use of the Galaxy platform.  I work one on one with scientists to perform data analysis tasks on request.  I participate in a collaboration with the Proteomics Shared Resource to develop new statistical methodologies for finer interpretation of quantitative mass spectrometry data (iTRAQ).  This collaboration has proved fruitful on a number of fronts.  Besides being a success thus far, work on this project has required me to develop skills for programming Nvidia's CUDA technology for GPGPU computing to accelerate computations by a factor around 10e7.  I have also developed a Perl CGI web interface for managing the submission and execution of analysis jobs for multiple users.  I maintain a number of Linux and Mac OS X servers along with wen services they provide.  For example, I have been maintaining and extending a web interface for interactive graphical exploration of data in plant genetics.  I also do some active extension and development to add new features and the latest tools to the Galaxy platform.  For example, at the time of this writing, I am working on a project to enable Galaxy to tap into the power of CSHL's supercomputing cluster.

positions.title: Software Developement Engineer in Test Intern (Windows)
positions.description: Developed a tool and library for writing test failure analysis (TFA) automation. Exploratory work in log-based TFA automation.

positions.title: Software Developement Engineer in Test Intern (Server & Tools Business)
positions.description: Design and collaborative development of a distributed automated testing system for Windows Rights Management Server

positions.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellow (Dr. Erik Winfree's Lab)
positions.description: Studied strategies for mapping logical computations onto the dynamics of DNA-based chemical "circuits" (reaction networks), and developed and optimized a 4-bit adder circuit as a proof of concept.

positions.title: Research Intern (Dr. Dmitri Chklovskii's Lab)
positions.description: Studied statistical properties of the topology of the C. elegans nervous system.  Collaborated on image processing algorithms for serial reconstruction of cellular morphology from electron micrographs of tissue slices.

positions.title: Research Intern (Dr. Jerry C.P. Yin's Lab)
positions.description: Studied the roles of Fragile X Mental Retardation Protein (FMRP) and Protein Kinase C-zeta (PKC-zeta) in regulation of learning and memory at the synapse in D. melanogaster.

positions.title: Independent Researcher (Dr. Sebastian Seung's Lab)
positions.description: Conceived and developed the basis for an information theoretic approach to identify multi-neuronal topologies that give rise to spontaneous patterned activity.  Implemented simulation engine to generate required data by numerical integration of multi-neuron spiking networks based on the Hodgkin-Huxley model.

projects.title: UAV R&D aka NYC Robotics
projects.description: We are mostly hobbyists of mixed but nicely complementary skill levels collaborating to test our ingenuity in designing and constructing a flying robot initially targeted for the DARPA UAVForge Competition.  There are plenty non-military / humanitarian / service applications for the technology, and while we are keeping them in mind as we go, we will be able to target them much more directly once the competition passes.

publications.title: Introducing PathQuery, Google's Graph Query Language
